executive_summary: OFAC added 10 new entities and individuals to the SDN list on June 3, 2026, primarily targeting individuals and entities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Iran. The additions are associated with various programs, including DRCONGO, IRAN-EO13902, and SDGT. The majority of the additions are related to Iranian entities and individuals, highlighting the ongoing focus on Iran-related sanctions.

risk_implications.description: The additions of Iranian entities and individuals to the SDN list increase the risk of inadvertently conducting transactions with sanctioned parties, highlighting the need for enhanced due diligence and screening

risk_implications.area: Democratic Republic of the Congo-related transactions
risk_implications.description: The addition of individuals related to the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the SDN list may pose a moderate risk to companies operating in the region, requiring increased vigilance in customer and transaction screening

program_highlights.note: Two individuals were added to the SDN list under the DRCONGO program, indicating ongoing efforts to target individuals involved in activities related to the Democratic Republic of the Congo
Five entities and individuals were added to the SDN list under the IRAN-EO13902 program, highlighting the continued focus on Iran-related sanctions
Five individuals were added to the SDN list under the SDGT program, indicating ongoing efforts to target individuals involved in terrorist activities
